newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble eases after T-bill sales, on C.Bank rates.
newsitem.headline: Rouble eases after T-bill sales, on C.Bank rates.

text.p: The rouble eased on Wednesday in line with lower central bank rates after banks stopped setting aside funds for today's Treasury bill auctions, dealers said.
Roubles/dollar Nov 20 midday Nov 20 early Nov 19 close
Today the central bank is auctioning eight trillion roubles of new six-month paper and an additional tranche of three trillion roubles of six-month bills.
"The central bank has raised its rates a little more than usual (one to three points). While it is going up, banks are looking upwards, too," said Moscow Business World Bank dealer Alexei Glukhov.
Neftekhimbank dealer Vladimir Zrazhevsky said: "Rouble demand was feverish ahead of the auctions. It is over now and the situation is rather calm."
Dealers said buying by a major bank was the main reason for Tuesday's rise in overnight rouble credit rates.
